prompts.text: Edit target: original canonical male hip thrust PNG supplied. Remove white floor only. Output a PNG with actual transparent alpha channel, NOT a checkerboard drawing. If transparency cannot be encoded, use perfectly flat solid green #00FF00 background including every open gap for subsequent chroma extraction. No checkerboard whatsoever. This is an animation frame and any movement of feet or bench is unacceptable.
